description: This file declares the KmlParser class, which provides static methods to parse KML files and strings to extract GPS fixes, used in location-based services within the Android project.

classes.name: KmlParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse KML files and strings to extract GPS fix data.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a .kml file at the specified file path and extracts GPS fixes into the provided array; returns true on success.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a string containing KML data and extracts GPS fixes into the provided array; returns true on success.
